zendure.title: Zendure device
zendure.description: Enter the IP address of the Zendure device. The local API must be enabled: in the Zendure app add HEMS, then exit the app.

external_meter.title: External P1 meter
external_meter.description: A second grid meter for the battery controller. Which meter is used is chosen with the Meter source select on the battery (default: auto). HomeWizard: switch on Local API in the HomeWizard Energy app first.

data.external_meter_interval_ms: Milliseconds between polls (100-1000; below 1000 only for YouLess)

homewizard_confirm.title: HomeWizard P1 meter found
homewizard_confirm.description: Use the HomeWizard P1 meter at {host} (serial {serial}) as grid meter for the battery? Local API must be switched on in the HomeWizard Energy app.

ha_sensor.title: Home Assistant sensor
ha_sensor.description: A power sensor already in Home Assistant, import positive. With separate import and export sensors, both positive, also choose the export sensor. A sensor that updates less than once a second shows as stale between updates; Meter source auto then uses the Zendure meter.

error.cannot_connect: No response. Check the IP address and that the local API is enabled.
error.no_identity: The device answered but reported neither a serial number nor a device id.
error.wrong_meter_type: The address answers, but not as this meter type. Check the meter type.
error.homewizard_api_off: The meter does not answer. Switch on Local API in the HomeWizard Energy app and try again.
error.not_a_power_sensor: This sensor has no power reading right now (unit W or kW, numeric state).
error.same_entity: The export sensor must differ from the power sensor.
